paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The average probing accuracy using different MLP variations. We indicate the size(s) of hidden layer(s) in square brackets.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average probing accuracy of mBERT and XLM-R models across various hidden layer configurations. The horizontal axis displays a series of categories, including “hidden[50], linear,” “hidden[100], linear,” “hidden[50], ReLU,” and “hidden[100], ReLU,” presented in left-to-right order. The value axis, labeled “% point difference,” ranges from approximately -0.25 to 0.2, with a linear scale indicated. The vertical axis ticks are spaced at intervals of 0.05, and the units are “point difference.” The bar corresponding to mBERT, colored in light blue, has a height of approximately 0.15, and the bar for XLM-R, colored in dark blue, has a height of approximately 0.2.  The chart shows that XLM-R consistently demonstrates higher probing accuracies than mBERT across all listed hidden layer configurations, with the tallest bar representing XLM-R’s performance on the “hidden[100], ReLU” configuration.  All bars are presented in their original order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
